name: testsets4.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-sort TopLevelDeclarations) (declare-const mk-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)
(declare-datatypes () ((Event (mk-Event (time Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Events (mk-Events (s (Set Ref))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Event (sel-Event Event))
  (lift-Events (sel-Events Events))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Event ((this Ref)) Event
  (sel-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Events ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Events (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Events ((this Ref)) Events
  (sel-Events (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Event this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Events ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Events this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Event:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Event.time: ---

(define-fun Event.time ((this Ref)) Int
  (time (deref-Event this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Events:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Events.s: ---

(define-fun Events!s ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (s (deref-Events this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Event:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Event Event)



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Events:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Events Events)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Events.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (Events!s this) ((as const (Set Int)) false)))
)

(assert (! (Events.inv1 2) :named _xkassert246))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Events.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (forall ((e Ref)) (=> (select (Events!s this) e) (>= (Event.time e) 0)))
)

(assert (! (Events.inv2 2) :named _xkassert247))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Event const-1-Event))
        2 (lift-Events const-2-Events))
  )
)
smtModel:
;; universe for TopLevelDeclarations:
;;   TopLevelDeclarations!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun TopLevelDeclarations!val!0 () TopLevelDeclarations)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x TopLevelDeclarations)) (= x TopLevelDeclarations!val!0))
;; -----------
(define-fun const-2-Events () Events
  (mk-Events (_ as-array k!0)))
(define-fun const-1-Event () Event
  (mk-Event 7719))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (_ as-array k!5))
(define-fun k!3 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
    null))
(define-fun k!0 ((x!1 Int)) Bool
  (ite (= x!1 1) true
    false))
(define-fun k!4 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-Event (mk-Event 7719))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
    null)))
(define-fun k!1 ((x!1 Int)) Bool
  false)
(define-fun k!5 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-Events (mk-Events (_ as-array k!0)))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-Event (mk-Event 7719))
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
    null))))
(define-fun k!2 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  null)
